data.one_liner: A customizable slider button widget for activating or deactivating events.
data.what_it_does: Provides a slider button widget that users can drag across to trigger actions like canceling transactions or screens. It offers support for circular or rectangular shapes, customizable sizes, shimmer labels, haptic vibration, and glassmorphism effects.
use_when: You need a slide-to-confirm or slide-to-cancel UI pattern.
You require a highly customizable slider button with optional haptic feedback and shimmer effects.
avoid_when: You need standard buttons like elevated buttons or floating action buttons.
You require complex gesture systems outside of a linear horizontal slide track.
strengths: Highly customizable with radius, sizing, colors, glass effect, and RTL support.
Includes optional haptic vibration and shimmer text labeling.
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific UI pattern (slider button).
Does not document advanced non-linear slider interactions.
data.minimal_example:
SliderButton(
  action: () async {
    return true;
  },
  label: Text(
    "Slide to cancel !",
    style: TextStyle(
        color: Color(0xff4a4a4a),
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        fontSize: 17),
  ),
  icon: Center(
      child: Icon(
    Icons.power_settings_new,
    color: Colors.white,
    size: 40.0,
  )),
  width: 230,
  radius: 10,
  buttonColor: Color(0xffd60000),
  backgroundColor: Color(0xff534bae),
  highlightedColor: Colors.white,
  baseColor: Colors.red,
);
